intro: Lesson 37: Important Lessons unit 5: ihsan. To understand ihsan, the highest level of the religion, and how it changes the way we worship and treat others

questions.q: Explain the two levels of ihsan.
questions.a: Worshipping as though you see Allah (love, focus), and if not, knowing He sees you (watchfulness).
questions.model: Point: ihsan has two levels. Evidence: the hadith of Jibril (Muslim). Explain: the higher is worship with the heart present as if seeing Allah; the lower is knowing He sees us, which stops sin.

questions.q: 'Allah has prescribed ihsan in all things' is reported by ...
options: No one: it is not a hadith

questions.q: Ihsan audit on the pupil PDF: for salah, homework, family and online life, write what ihsan looks like and one change you will make. Long answer in the portal response box: 'Ihsan in my life means ...'
questions.a: Four areas with specific changes, linked to the hadith of Jibril and Shaddad's hadith
questions.model: Teacher fills salah: 'Ihsan: pray calmly, think about the meaning. Change: arrive at the mat before the iqamah.'

questions.q: how does ihsan link to the udhiyah?
questions.a: Ihsan with the animal: sharp blade, no suffering (Muslim)

questions.q: Ihsan is to worship Allah as though ...
Back to our ponder: how would knowing Allah sees you change your work?
questions.a: Pupils' own: careful, sincere, best effort
